A1.title: R1 coverage
A1.anchor: All 21 O0/O1/O2 entries for N=2,...,8, with intervals/uncertainties or justified unresolved; deduct corresponding coverage for missing entries

A2.title: R1 basis for phase classification
A2.anchor: Increasing two-dimensional sizes, probability coverage, statistics, and extrapolation sufficiently support the classifications; slow decline/apparent plateaus alone do not determine zero/positive limits; a theorem can directly support a phase region without mandatory repeat MC

A3.title: R1 uncertainty control
A3.anchor: Statistical, finite-size, and approximation errors reported separately, with justified numerical error estimates; chi differences are not presented as true-bias upper bounds. Do not repeat deductions here for gaps in central-region limiting-risk inference already scored under A2

A4.title: R1 figure and classification semantics
A4.anchor: Distinguish rigorous sufficient bounds, rigorous undecodability, numerical boundaries, and unknowns; bound roots are not true transitions; figures/tables agree with answers

A5.title: R1 structural consistency
A5.anchor: Phase classifications respect information inclusion/equivalence classes, inheriting subsets where necessary; handle the N4 anomaly and asymmetry appropriately; individual sufficient bounds need not all be strictly nested

B1.title: R2 model/geometry
B1.anchor: Correct noise, conditional independence of observations, boundaries, and binary success condition; no access to hidden information or replacement of the noise channel

B2.title: R2 information order
B2.anchor: O2-to-O1-to-O0 degradation, risk inequalities, and inclusion of decodable sets; cross-N ordering must actually be proved if used

B3.title: R2 charge equivalence
B3.anchor: O1(N2)=O0, N3=N6, N5=N7=N8 reveal full integer q, and N4 is a separate class; only relations relied on by the answer need proof; incorrect all-N monotonicity is not rewarded

B4.title: R2 special ranks
B4.anchor: Correct irrep probabilities and small-N exceptions where used, particularly SU2 and N4 determinant coincidences; avoid the incorrect identification O2(N2)=O0

C1.title: R3 statement
C1.anchor: Explicit integer N0, every N>=N0 and every p, and the risk conclusion as L tends to infinity; domain and endpoints complete

C2.title: R3 witness/decoder
C2.anchor: A valid auxiliary rule and feasible witness, or an equivalent valid direct Bayes/posterior argument; the implication from failure to a spanning component and its required conditions is sound; hiding is not mistaken for sufficiency

C3.title: R3 correlations
C3.anchor: Valid treatment of shared-edge orientations, side edges/chords, and conditional independence of readouts; effective alternatives such as matrices, stochastic coarse-graining, and grouped Cauchy-Schwarz are accepted equally

C4.title: R3 exponential bound and certification
C4.anchor: Fixed-path probability, path count, length lower bound, strict all-p factor<1, and finite prefactor; numerical optimization alone without a certified global maximum warrants a reservation

C5.title: R3 scope of conclusions
C5.anchor: Sufficient N0 is clearly not the minimum/a phase boundary, and r>=1 does not mean undecodability; evidence is auditable; smaller N0 separately records result strength

D1.title: R4 joint partition sum
D1.anchor: Preserve shared orientations at the two ends of the same edge, with correct local probabilities and logical sectors; do not independently orient vertices or replace sector posterior with MAP

D2.title: R4 exact algorithm
D2.anchor: Exact or certified as required for L<=4,N<=8; explain contraction/enumeration and complexity; approximations at larger L do not compromise the small-size commitment

D3.title: R4 independent verification
D3.anchor: Compare against independent enumeration/reference without reusing the same core error; evidence supports the required precision and coverage; retain the limitations of existing external heldout checks

D4.title: R4 numerical range
D4.anchor: Positive-probability records are not misclassified as zero through underflow; normalization/log/high precision and endpoints work; distinguish platform differences from original-environment gaps

D5.title: decode interface
D5.anchor: Return a valid edge set with the correct syndrome and a logical decision compatible with the posterior rule used; exceptions and invalid outputs can be located

E1.title: answers.json
E1.anchor: Structure, 21 entries, endpoint uncertainties/unresolved forms, and R3_N0 agree with the report

E2.title: Report/figures
E2.anchor: Phase diagram, R2/R3 proofs, evidence, and limitations are provided in locatable files; scientific points are not deducted for personal aesthetic preferences

E3.title: Source/reproduction/resources
E3.anchor: API, dependency environment, commands, seeds/resource descriptions support reproduction; the 8CPU/32GiB/no-GPU requirements are documented

E4.title: Data/unconditional accounting
E4.anchor: Raw data, seeds, stopping rules, trial denominators, and exceptions/invalid outputs counted as failures; reserved slots distinguished from actual execution
